title: Intrinsic identity coherence for finite dualizing restriction
statement: For every coefficient level n, the inverse intrinsic restriction comparison followed by the normalized DVR identity unit equals the comparison-site identity restriction unit transported through the intrinsic realization equivalence.

source.place: Identity normalization of the intrinsic comparison

proof.text: The identity ideal-quotient factor is the identity on every residue class. The lifted constant-ring morphism is therefore the identity, by functoriality of constant sheafification. Restriction along that identity is the identity functor, and its eqToIso acts as the identity on sections.

The sheafification-adjunction unit on a fixed-coefficient module sheaf is an isomorphism: the underlying abelian presheaf is already a sheaf, so its sheafification unit is invertible. Evaluation is therefore surjective on scalar-unit sections. Naturality of that adjunction unit describes realization of a map on those sections.

For any finite coefficient ring and any endomorphism equal to its identity, use the normalization from finiteDualizingRestriction_existsUnique to evaluate the chosen ordinary restriction comparison on scalar-unit sections. Naturality identifies its composite with realization of normalizedOriginRestrictionUnit with the identity on each section. Surjectivity of the scalar-unit map proves the ordinary identity square, including its specified eqToIso identification on intrinsic modules.

Apply the published Functor.mapDerivedCategorySquareIso_hom_app_id to that ordinary square. Cancel the comparison isomorphism to obtain the inverse comparison followed by the derived intrinsic unit. Transport along finiteDualizingRestriction_eq, using the HEq characterization in finiteDualizingIntrinsicRestriction_existsUnique, and identify the transported unit with normalizedDVRResUnit by proof irrelevance of the functor equality. Extensionality of natural isomorphisms and the identity components of the unitors give precisely the stated equality.

proof_origin.place: Identity normalization of the intrinsic comparison; section normalization and exact-localization identity coherence

theorem finiteDualizingIntrinsicRestriction_unit (n : ℕ) :
    (finiteDualizingIntrinsicRestriction l E X (le_refl n)).symm ≪≫
        Functor.isoWhiskerLeft
          (sfIntrinsicDerivedEquivalence X
            (Padic.coefficientExtensionRing l E (n + 1))).functor
          (normalizedDVRResUnit l E X n) ≪≫
        Functor.rightUnitor _ =
      Functor.isoWhiskerRight
          (Functor.mapDerivedCategoryNatIso
            (ProEtale.normalizedOriginRestrictionUnit (Scheme.ProEt.topology X)
              (finiteDualizingQuotient l E (le_refl n))
              (by rw [finiteDualizingQuotient_id l E n])) ≪≫
            Functor.mapDerivedCategoryIdIso _)
          (sfIntrinsicDerivedEquivalence X
            (Padic.coefficientExtensionRing l E (n + 1))).functor ≪≫
        Functor.leftUnitor _
